ShyvanaR.name: Dragon's Descent
ShyvanaR.tooltip:
Passive: Shyvana generates @Fury_Generation@ Dragon Fury by striking enemies with Attacks and Abilities, increased by @TT_Fury_Mult@ while in Dragon Form, and reduced @TT_Fury_AoE_Penalty@ by when striking in an area against non-champions.

Active: Shyvana transforms into her Dragon Form, becoming Unstoppable, and flying to the target location breathing fire on enemies below dealing @Damage@ magic damage and causing them Flee for @FearDuration@ seconds.

While transformed, Shyvana's basic Abilities are upgraded, she gains @Calc_Bonus_Health@ bonus Health, size, and Attack Range. Shyvana loses Dragon Fury over time and her transformation ends when she has no Dragon Fury remaining.
Shyvana gains @FuryGainPerUltHaste*100@% increased Fury from all sources per 1 Ultimate Ability Haste. Ultimate Haste acquired while dead does not take effect until Shyvana revives.

ShyvanaQ.name: Emberstrike
ShyvanaQ.tooltip:
Passive: Shyvana's Attacks deal @Calc_Max_Health_Damage@ max Health magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit and reduce this Ability's Cooldown by @Cooldown_Reduction@ seconds.

Active: Shyvana's next Attack strikes the target and the surrounding area dealing @Calc_Damage@ physical damage. This Ability may be Recast after an Attack or short delay within the next @RecastDuration@ seconds.

Dragon Form: Shyvana gains an additional Recast, causing her to bite the target of her next Attack dealing @Calc_Dragon_Form_Damage@ true damage.
Deals @Calc_Monster_Bonus@ additional damage to monsters.
Maximum health damage does not affect structures and against non-champions has a minimum of @Calc_Max_Health_Monster_Minimum@ and maximum of @Calc_Max_Health_Monster_Maximum@.
Dragon Form's final Recast cannot critically strike.

ShyvanaE.name: Molten Burst
ShyvanaE.tooltip:
Shyvana launches a fireball at the target location dealing @Damage@ + @Calc_Max_Health_Damage@ Max health magic damage and Slowing by @Calc_Slow@ for @SlowDuration@ seconds. It explodes upon striking an enemy or reaching its terminus.

Dragon Form: Shyvana's fireball is larger and pierces through enemies. Upon striking a champion, large monster, or reaching its terminus it triggers a pulse of fire that deals @Calc_Dragon_Damage@ + @Calc_Max_Health_Dragon_Damage@ Max Health magic damage and Slows by @Calc_Slow_Dragon@ for @SlowDuration@ seconds. The fireball leaves behind a trail for @GroundLingerDuration@ seconds that deals @DamagePerSecond@ magic damage per second.
Overlapping Dragon Form explosions deal @Calc_Multihit_Efficacy@ damage.

ShyvanaW.name: Inferno Aegis
ShyvanaW.tooltip:
Shyvana wraps herself in flames for @Duration@ seconds, gaining @Calc_Shield@ Shield, increased by @Calc_Shield_Per_Nearby_Champion@ per nearby enemy champion and @MoveSpeed@ Move Speed, increased to @MoveSpeedTowardsEnemies@ when moving towards enemy champions.

When the effect ends, the Shield is broken, or upon Recast the area around her detonates, dealing @Damage@ magic damage.

Dragon Form: If the detonation hits an enemy champion Shyvana heals for @Calc_Base_Heal@ + @Calc_Missing_Health_Heal@ Missing Health.

Takedowns on champions, large minions, and monsters earn Shyvana stacks of Scalemail %i:Shyvana%, each stack grants Shyvana permanent @BonusArmor@ Armor and @BonusMagicResist@ Magic Resist.

Bonus Armor: @Calc_Bonus_Armor@
Bonus Magic Resist: @Calc_Bonus_MR@

rules.label: Empowered attack bonus
rules.note: Emberstrike counts only what it adds to its two empowered attacks; put two basic attacks after it in the combo.

rules.label: Dragon Form bite
rules.note: In Dragon Form the bite is counted as a whole attack, on-hit effects included: do not add an auto attack for it.

notes: A critical strike is counted on the attacks themselves, not on what Emberstrike adds to them.

rules.label: Dragon Form explosion
rules.note: One Dragon Form explosion of Molten Burst is counted; a second, overlapping one at reduced damage is not.

rules.label: Fire trail
rules.note: In Dragon Form the target is counted as standing in Molten Burst's fire trail for its whole duration.
